description: Use when you already have the UUID of a public co-op (for example from list_public_coops) and need its full public profile. Do not use it to search by name, or for a private co-op: private co-ops return an error, and no private land, members, evidence or financial records are ever returned. Returns the co-op's public profile (name, region, country, summary, public projects and events) as self-reported community text, plus a source receipt and the vergecommon.com page for that co-op.
name: get_public_coop
